meta.description: 366 birthday colors with Japanese traditional color data. Each entry contains all color values, seasonal info, personality traits, and color meanings.

fields.id: Unique ID in format MM-DD (e.g. '01-01' for Jan 1)
fields.season: One of: Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter
fields.color_name_jp: Traditional color name in Japanese kanji/kana
fields.lab: CIE L*a*b* values object {l, a, b}
fields.cmyk: CMYK values object {c, m, y, k}
